notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Square plates that look entirely white when blurred; a few cars lack a front plate despite the rule.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Black car with a roof rack, found nowhere else.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Semi-arid climate, so cacti are common.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Simple pastel one-storey bungalows; metal roofs on small shacks, tiled roofs on pricier houses, and the odd multi-storey villa.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: The coloured border of road signs, red or blue, continues onto the back of the sign.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Blue street name signs mounted on top of yellow signposts are common.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Traffic light posts with white and black stripes appear in urban areas.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Wooden poles with three horizontal, alternating insulators are common.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The west is semi-arid rural land with green but dry hills, widely spaced houses and narrow roads.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: A line of wind turbines in the southeast, with rainy coverage.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: The wide four-lane bridge in the main city has yellow and blue guardrails and a city view.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: In the centre of the island a stick is stuck to the front of the camera lens near Grote Berg.
